pairs.subject: copy-quality-gates
pairs.evidence: lib/articles/checks.ts:14 The article checking pipeline leaves failures advisory for a human gate rather than enforcing layered blocking gates with anchored model reviews and declared severities.

techniques.evidence: lib/articles/critique.ts:191 Critique validation accepts free-form location and suggestion text rather than anchored rule identifiers, verbatim quoted spans, and minimal replacements.
lib/articles/checks.ts:25 Mechanically checkable constraints and thresholds are shared directly with writer prompts rather than separating prompt guidance from checker enforcement.
lib/articles/checkLoop.ts:23 All check failures, including unambiguous typographic issues, are routed to an LLM agent fix turn instead of being repaired deterministically by script.
lib/articles/checkLoop.ts:81 Remaining check failures after max fix passes do not block the pipeline from completing, yielding execution without diff-scoped write-seam gating.
lib/articles/checksStatic.ts:29 Checks run as a linear imperative array push without a declarative precondition graph to suppress cascading dependent failures.
lib/articles/checksReport.ts:28 Check results are flattened and sorted only by status for human review rather than enforcing layered L1 blocking versus precision-earned L2/L3 warnings.
lib/articles/checksRendered.ts:134 Rendered checks inspect page-level viewport scroll rather than evaluating per-surface box clipping budgets or banded ratio-to-source limits.
lib/articles/checksText.ts:28 Prose is extracted via regex stripping into a single string rather than extracting discrete addressable units tagged with surface classes and verified coverage counts.
lib/articles/critique.ts:106 Reviewers are configured by model engine and ID without role separation or qualification on seeded defect sets to measure clean-set edit rates.
lib/articles/checksItems.ts:14 Check severities are hardcoded as binary pass/fail status in item constructors rather than declared as external configuration data with a cascading rubric.
lib/articles/checks.ts:28 The article authoring and check pipeline operates strictly on English copy with no target locales, so cross-language agreement does not apply.

pairs.registryProposal: The standard assumes copy quality gates govern multi-locale UI catalogs with discrete keys; extending it to long-form prose synthesis requires distinguishing full-document architectural rhythms from string-level catalog constraints.
